title: Minuta 2026-05-07
summary: The minutes of the 7 May meeting confirm a 3-2 cut to 6.50% that closes the easing cycle, and the member-by-member discussion is more hawkish than the communique: none of the five members argues for further cuts, the majority members describe the cut as the last one or as a fine-tuning with the rate held at the new level, and the two dissenters argue the stance was already neutral. Heath says the margin for additional cuts is 'practicamente nulo' with the real rate in the neutral range and the rate differential to the US near historic lows, and wants a prolonged pause; Borja says cutting could hinder convergence given persistent services inflation and unfavourable base effects. The majority's case rests on a sharper-than-expected Q1 contraction, widening slack, a stronger peso and the view that the oil and jitomate shocks are transitory relative-price adjustments, while the risk balance stays tilted to the upside and short- and medium-term expectations moved up. Versus the March minutes, where the majority still weighed an additional cut and the debate was about timing, the Board now unanimously looks to a hold and the hawkish wing frames the remaining restriction as exhausted; read against the same meeting's communique, the minutes are half a point more hawkish because they show how firmly the door to more easing is shut.

key_quotes.quote: Aseveró que, ante ambos factores, el margen para recortes adicionales en la tasa objetivo sin que con ello se comprometa la convergencia a la meta es prácticamente nulo.
key_quotes.context: Heath: real ex-ante rate in neutral range and rate differential near historic lows leave no room for cuts

key_quotes.quote: la pausa planteada en principio debería ser de naturaleza prolongada.
key_quotes.context: Heath's dissent calls for a prolonged pause

key_quotes.quote: el ajuste debe entenderse como un ajuste fino dentro de un contexto de restricción monetaria y no como la adopción de una postura acomodaticia.
key_quotes.context: A majority member frames the cut as fine-tuning within a still-restrictive stance, with the rate held at the new level afterwards

key_quotes.quote: considero que reducir la tasa podría dificultar el proceso de convergencia.
key_quotes.context: Borja's dissent: supply shocks, services persistence and base effects argue for caution and a hold
